faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the FSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the FSI Recruitment 2026 is 05-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the FSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the FSI Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are for the posts of Senior Deckhand-cum-Cook, Carpenter, Machinist, and Welder.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the FSI posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all the posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for government servants.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the FSI posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. Generally, candidates need to have passed the 10th standard or SSLC or equivalent, along with an ITI Certificate in the relevant trade for specific posts.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the FSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the FSI Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the FSI posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 5200 to Rs. 20200 Per Month, with different Grade Pays and Pay Levels depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the FSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the FSI Recruitment 2026 will include a Written Test and a Skill Test. Candidates need to qualify in both stages to be considered for the final selection.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the FSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for FSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is advisable to read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these FSI recruitments?
faq.answer: The job type for all the advertised posts in the FSI Recruitment 2026 is Full Time.
